Portal (architecture)
A
portal
is an opening in a wall of a building, gate or fortification, especially a grand entrance to an important structure.
[
1
]
[
page
needed
]
Doors, metal
gates
, or
portcullis
in the opening can be used to control entry or exit. The surface surrounding the opening may be made of simple building materials or decorated with
ornamentation
. The elements of a portal can include the
voussoir
,
tympanum
, an ornamented
mullion
or
trumeau
between doors, and
columns
with carvings of saints in the
westwork
of a
church
.
[
citation needed
]
Examples
Other uses
The term
portal
is also applied to the ends of a
tunnel
.
